name: Dynamic Volume Texture Slice Rendering
definition: A technique to render into a specific depth slice of a 3D volume texture by using a RenderTarget with a slice parameter, allowing dynamic updates to volume data (e.g., fog) on both WebGL2 and WebGPU backends.
summary: Dynamic Volume Texture Slice Rendering updates specific depth slices of a 3D volume texture individually, allowing dynamic volumetric data updates on the GPU by treating the volume as independent 2D slices rather than a monolithic buffer.
